title: “As Eastern Powers, I Will Veto.” : An Investigation of Nation-Level Bias of Large Language Models in International Relations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using a three-part framework focused on UN Security Council permanent members: 1) Direct Question-Answering (DirectQA) to explicitly ask models which nation is more irresponsible; 2) Association Tests to explicitly rank nations based on their relevance to domain-specific international relations keywords; and 3) Persona-Assigned Vote Simulations to measure implicit bias by comparing LLM-simulated votes to actual historical UN voting records.
